Transmissor Localizador de Emergência

A radio beacon automatically activated to transmit a distress signal, assisting search and rescue in locating an aircraft in distress.

Questions and answers

What is Transmissor Localizador de Emergência?

In this glossary, Transmissor Localizador de Emergência refers to: A radio beacon automatically activated to transmit a distress signal, assisting search and rescue in locating an aircraft in distress.

How is Transmissor Localizador de Emergência used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "O Transmissor Localizador de Emergência foi ativado automaticamente após o pouso forçado, auxiliando as equipes de resgate a localizar a aeronave."

Definition

A radio beacon automatically activated to transmit a distress signal, assisting search and rescue in locating an aircraft in distress.

Operational example

The Emergency Locator Transmitter was activated automatically after the forced landing, aiding rescue teams in locating the aircraft.

Localized term

Transmissor Localizador de Emergência

Localized example

O Transmissor Localizador de Emergência foi ativado automaticamente após o pouso forçado, auxiliando as equipes de resgate a localizar a aeronave.
